wheel_turns.name: The Wheel Turns
wheel_turns.text: The target's attack this round strikes the foe beside it instead.

void_womb.name: Void Womb
void_womb.text: Gain 6 Ward and 6 Block. Shed 6 stress.

stutter.name: Stutter
stutter.text: Echo. Delay the target. Apply 1 Void.

time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
time_dilation.text: Delay the target. Stun it if it carries Lightning.

haste_all.name: Quickening
haste_all.text: Every hero gains 1 Momentum and draws 1 more next round.

frozen_moment.name: Frozen Moment
frozen_moment.text: The target cannot be moved, and is Delayed.

epoch.name: Epoch
epoch.text: Delay every foe and deal 5 to each. Exhaust.

cash_the_omen.name: Fulfil the Omen
cash_the_omen.text: Spend all Omen. Deal 4 per Omen spent.

omen_ward.name: Warding Omen
omen_ward.text: A hero gains 4 Block and 1 Ward per 2 Omen.

entrails.name: Entrails
entrails.text: Deal 5. If it kills, gain 2 Omen.

bank_the_stars.name: Bank the Stars
bank_the_stars.text: Next round, +2 vigour. Gain 1 Omen. Exhaust.

doomsday_clock.name: Doomsday Clock
doomsday_clock.text: Apply Doom equal to your Omen to every foe.

thread_cutter.name: Thread Cutter
thread_cutter.text: Deal 3, plus 4 per Prime spent this round.

woven_shield.name: Woven Shield
woven_shield.text: Every hero gains 2 Block, plus 2 per Prime spent this round.

tapestry.name: Tapestry
tapestry.text: Every foe takes 2, plus 3 per Prime spent this round.

severance.name: Severance
severance.text: Execute the target at 5 HP, plus 5 per Prime spent this round, or less.

k_transfer.name: Transfer
k_transfer.text: Lift every affliction from the most afflicted hero and lay it on the target.

k_unleash.name: Unleash
k_unleash.text: Consume the target's Hex. Deal 3 per stack.

withering.name: Withering
withering.text: Apply 2 Hex. The target loses its Might.

hex_ward.name: Hex Ward
hex_ward.text: A hero gains 2 Ward and 4 Block.

hex_bolt.name: Hex Bolt
hex_bolt.text: Deal 3, plus 1 per Hex on the target.

spite.name: Spite
spite.text: Deal 4, plus 1 per affliction you carry.

misfortune.name: Misfortune
misfortune.text: Apply 1 Hex. A foe already at 2+ Hex becomes Vulnerable.

absorb_pain.name: Absorb Pain
absorb_pain.text: Cleanse 3 afflictions from another hero. You gain 3 stress.

withering_glance.name: Withering Glance
withering_glance.text: The target loses 2 Armor. Apply 1 Hex.

dirge.name: Dirge
dirge.text: Deal 2 to every foe; 4 to those with Hex.

sour_milk.name: Sour Milk
sour_milk.text: Apply 1 Toxin to the target and the foes beside it.

hex_shield.name: Hexed Shield
hex_shield.text: Gain 3 Block, plus 1 per Hex on all foes.

hag_finger.name: Hag's Finger
hag_finger.text: Pull the target forward 1. Apply 1 Hex.

nightshade.name: Nightshade
nightshade.text: Apply 2 Toxin. Every hero sheds 2 stress.

rot_from_within.name: Rot from Within
rot_from_within.text: Deal 3 per Toxin on the target.

hex_spread.name: Contagion
hex_spread.text: The foes beside the target gain Hex equal to its Hex.

blight_bloom.name: Blight Bloom
blight_bloom.text: Apply 2 Toxin, then 1 Volatile Void: Blight.

burden_shift.name: Burden Shift
burden_shift.text: Lay your own afflictions on the target. Deal 2 per affliction moved.

bone_charm.name: Bone Charm
bone_charm.text: A hero gains 3 Ward and Regen 2.

wither_armor.name: Unmake Iron
wither_armor.text: The target loses 4 Armor. Apply 2 Toxin.

curse_of_weakness.name: Curse of Frailty
curse_of_weakness.text: The target is Vulnerable for 2 rounds. Apply 1 Hex.

weeping_sores.name: Weeping Sores
weeping_sores.text: Apply Bleed equal to the target's Toxin, then 1 Toxin.

unleash_all.name: Unleash All
unleash_all.text: Consume Hex from every foe. Each takes 2 per Hex consumed so far.

mourners_veil.name: Mourner's Veil
mourners_veil.text: Every hero gains 2 Ward and sheds 3 stress.

blood_moon.name: Blood Moon
blood_moon.text: Deal 6, plus 1 per 2 HP you are missing.

hex_lock.name: Hex Lock
hex_lock.text: Stun the target if it has 5+ Hex.

grand_malediction.name: Grand Malediction
grand_malediction.text: Apply 4 Hex to every foe. Exhaust.

death_curse.name: Death Curse
death_curse.text: Execute the target if its HP is 3x its Hex or less.

plaguebringer.name: Plaguebringer
plaguebringer.text: Apply 3 Toxin and 1 Hex to every foe.

soul_rend.name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.text: Deal 6 true damage, plus 2 per Hex, ignoring Block and Armor.

pact_of_bones.name: Pact of Bones
pact_of_bones.text: Lose 8 HP. Next round, +2 vigour. Exhaust.

blackest_night.name: Blackest Night
blackest_night.text: Apply 2 Void to every foe. Every hero sheds 8 stress.

scapegoat.name: Scapegoat
scapegoat.text: Transfer the worst-afflicted hero's afflictions to the target, and turn its attack on its ally.

witching_hour.name: Witching Hour
witching_hour.text: Double the Hex on every foe. Exhaust.

lich_mark.name: Lich's Mark
lich_mark.text: Apply Doom equal to 3x the target's Hex.

devour.name: Devour
devour.text: Deal 10, healing all of it. Gain 5 stress.

pain_engine.name: Pain Engine
pain_engine.text: Deal damage equal to your missing HP.

open_the_door.name: Open the Door
open_the_door.text: Deal 10; 25 if you are at Death's Door.

deaths_ledger.name: Death's Ledger
deaths_ledger.text: Apply Doom equal to the HP the target is missing.

final_hour.name: The Final Hour
final_hour.text: Execute the target if its Doom has met its HP.

toll_of_bells.name: Toll of Bells
toll_of_bells.text: Double the Doom on every foe. Exhaust.

mirror_mirror.name: Mirror, Mirror
mirror_mirror.text: The target's attack this round strikes the foe beside it instead.

borrowed_curse.name: Borrowed Curse
borrowed_curse.text: Lay your afflictions on the target. Apply 1 Hex.

glass_ward.name: Glass Ward
glass_ward.text: A hero gains Riposte 3 and 2 Ward.

cracked_mirror.name: Cracked Mirror
cracked_mirror.text: Deal 4, plus 4 per Might the target holds.

silver_lie.name: Silver Lie
silver_lie.text: Take the target's Block as your own.

hall_of_mirrors.name: Hall of Mirrors
hall_of_mirrors.text: Every foe's attack this round strikes its neighbour instead. Exhaust.
